about: Susan N. Eisenberg attended law school and graduated from University of Miami School of Law in 1986. Susan Eisenberg began practicing law in 1986.
Susan Eisenberg is an attorney at Cozen O'Connor, helping people with Employment Litigation: Defense issues. Cozen O'Connor has an office in Miami, Florida, serving the local community.

Susan Eisenberg was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
